rules.statement: A mortgagee is not bound to give notice of his action to a lessee, whose deed was executed before but registered after the execution and registration of the mortgage bond.
rules.supporting_quote: The date of execution is the test of the applicability of section 643, and the section does not extend to instruments which, if they can be described at all as subsequent incumbrances, can only be described as such in a figurative sense on account of the artificial priority which the Registration Ordinance gives to a competing deed.
